note: Australia's: every non-citizen needs a visa in effect to travel there (Migration Act s. 42), the Act extending to Norfolk Island, Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands (s. 7). New Zealand citizens are granted a Special Category visa on arrival by showing their passport, with no application beforehand and no fixed stay. Holders of the passports the Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601) names, and citizens of the countries the eVisitor (subclass 651, free, applied for online) names, get an electronic authority before travel for stays of up to 3 months at a time: both are taken as an ETA here (British citizens qualify, not other British passports; Taiwan's ordinary passports only). Everyone else applies for a Visitor visa (subclass 600).
